The Bumbba Story: Born to Shake Things Up

2013

It all started back in 2013

When one of Bumbba's founders, Pau Ferrer, realized his furniture store business had a slight issue… okay, more like a massive problem. Scaling up meant spending a fortune on stores, warehouses, and all those lovely hidden costs businesses love so much.

But no one's here to waste time, so he decided to try something different: selling a sofa in a box online. Sounds great, right? Well, the market begged to differ. Back then, people weren’t quite ready to make large purchases online, and the idea of a vacuum-packed sofa arriving neatly in a box seemed more like a magic trick than reality. Initial tests were a cold splash of reality—people just weren't ready yet.

Boom! Massive hit.

But if you've got that shark mindset, you don't give up easily. Instead of sofas, Pau pivoted to another bedtime classic: mattresses. That's how Marmota was born, offering vacuum-packed mattresses shipped in a box. Boom! Massive hit. It went so well that he eventually sold the company to a major player in the industry.

Time to revive that ahead-of-its-time idea

Feeling unstoppable, he thought, "Why not give the sofa idea another shot?" Enter Pummba, a sofa-in-a-box concept co-founded with Josep Sanchez, which quickly took off.

But wait, the ultimate comeback was yet to happen. Now that people have finally embraced buying sofas online without hesitation and realized vacuum-packed doesn't mean compromising on quality, it was time to revive that ahead-of-its-time idea. But this time, with all the know-how and lessons from Marmota and Pummba in hand.

Comfier than your favorite Sunday pajamas

This is how Bumbba was born—a hybrid between a mattress and a sofa, designed to elevate relaxation to new heights. Comfier than your favorite Sunday pajamas, easier than pizza delivery, and simpler to assemble than making a sandwich. It's comfort reinvented—no fuss, no middlemen, with a single goal: letting you dive onto it and forget the world.

After years of revolutionizing rest, we've created something truly roundbreaking. Don't call it a sofa. Don't call it a bed. It's a Bumbba.
